new_value: {"notes":"Implemented bounded authenticated link replay persistence. Added alternating versioned Settings snapshots authenticated with a device-root-derived dedicated namespace key and anchored by an independent monotonic CAS authority. Snapshots bind the exact local public key and bounded exact peer public keys; authority-selected revision/digest detects rollback, deletion, corruption, stale/torn writes, and wrong roots. RX reserves a conservative 32-sequence floor before delivery, restores it as an all-seen window after reboot, and applies RAM mutations only after durable authority commit. TX reserves first-boot/reboot/runtime epochs before publication and fails terminally at epoch 255. Explicit peer removal persists before RAM deletion; protected capacity disables automatic LRU trust-lineage eviction. Integrated the durable commit API into link RX, TX wrap, L2 key load, disable/reinit, and peer removal. No dynamic allocation. Validation: host replay CMake/UBSan 1/1 PASS; isolated qemu_x86 replay_persist+Settings compile/runtime 9/9 PASS; full Link secure-backend qemu_x86 compile PASS; modified L2 key/peer/init object targets compile PASS with CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_REPLAY_PERSIST=y. Broader ping_l2 image remains blocked only by unrelated pre-existing Zephyr-4.1 coap_client.send_mutex API mismatch."}
